summary: This tutorial explains how to perform peer review using LibreOffice Writer's document tracking feature. It starts by opening an existing document and setting up "Record Changes" to track edits. Users can add comments, delete text, or make changes that are clearly visible in the document. The document owner can accept or reject these changes and then incorporate them back into the document when saved. The tutorial uses documents like "svenreasonstoadoptfoss.odt" and "governmyntsupportforfossinindia.odt". It demonstrates how to insert text, delete text, and add comments. The document shows different colors for each editor's changes, making it easy to see who made what edits. The tutorial also highlights how multiple reviewers can edit the same document simultaneously, with each change highlighted in a different color. Finally, it opens a document that has been reviewed by a colleague, showing various additions and deletions made during the review process.
